name: Cerberus Fossae representative faults
source: USGS Scientific Investigations Map 3292 structure layer (Tanaka et al., 2014)
schema_note: Drop-in replacement for this file. Keep a GeoJSON FeatureCollection of LineStrings in degrees (longitude, latitude; west negative). properties.kinematics must be 'normal' or 'thrust'. Optional dip_deg overrides the dip slider. Optional dip_azimuth_deg (clockwise from north) overrides the dip direction. Otherwise the dip comes from the selected source (Wheeler measured, HiRISE programmatic, or the literature fallback) and the dip direction is a measured wall azimuth when the segment is subparallel to that wall, or else the right-hand normal of the segment. SIM 3292 stores graben axes and ridge crests, not dipping planes.
